answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 146474 Country: India Title: In fasting period (roza), while making wudhu or bathing, if water put to wash into eyes. Will the fast remain or break? Question: In fasting period (roza), while making wudhu or bathing, if water put to wash into eyes. Will the fast remain or break? Answer ID: 146474 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 215/205/B=3/1438) Fast does not break if water enters in the eye while making wudhu or ghusl, the fast shall remain intact. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
